sources.title: Presidential Decree 189/23: tourist-visa waiver for 98 countries
sources.publisher: Official Portal of the Government of Angola
sources.officialityEvidence: The live central government portal identifies the decree, states its tourist-only scope and lists every one of its 98 beneficiary countries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: cidadãos de 98 países estão isentos de visto para entrar em Angola

sources.title: Consulate General of Angola in Johannesburg: tourist visas outside the 98-country list
sources.publisher: Consulate General of Angola in Johannesburg / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MIREX diplomatic-mission portal expressly distinguishes tourist-visa services for visitors not covered by the 98-country entry-waiver list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: concessão de vistos de turismo àqueles que não estejam contemplados na lista dos 98 países

sources.title: Migration Governance Indicators 2025 launch
sources.publisher: Embassy of Angola in Saudi Arabia / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The MIREX mission portal records the SME Director-General confirming the 98-country tourism exemption and simplification regime in 2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: regime de isenção e simplificação de vistos de turismo para cidadãos de 98 países

sources.title: SME: foreign-user travel-visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live SME service is the official Angola Migration and Foreigners Service portal, links the Government portal, and provides foreign-user visa registration and request monitoring.
sources.supportingExcerpt: I’m not Angolan — Request and monitor your VISA

sources.title: Council of Ministers approval: Philippines tourist-waiver instrument
sources.publisher: Embassy of Angola in Saudi Arabia / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: A live MIREX mission news page reports Council of Ministers approval of an instrument relating to the Philippines, but does not supply promulgation or an effective date.
sources.supportingExcerpt: aprovado o diploma que integra a República das Filipinas no leque de países abrangidos
